stories.headline: Senate rejects Lula's STF nominee Messias in historic first, triggering political crisis
stories.summary: Brazil's Senate voted 42-34 to reject Solicitor General Jorge Messias as Lula's nominee to the Supreme Court, the first such rejection in 132 years. The defeat exposed deep fractures between the executive and the conservative-dominated Congress, with fallout including Messias signaling he may leave his post, Lula absorbing blame for political miscalculation, and speculation about the next nominee focusing on a Black woman.

stories.headline: Congress overrides Lula veto on Dosimetria bill, reducing sentences for Jan. 8 convicts including Bolsonaro
stories.summary: Brazil's Chamber and Senate voted to override Lula's veto of the Dosimetria bill, which reduces sentences for coup-related crimes and could cut Bolsonaro's 27-year sentence by several years. Lula signaled he would not promulgate the law, leaving it to Senate President Alcolumbre. PT announced plans to challenge the law at the STF, though analysts noted the court has little appetite for a quick reversal.

stories.headline: Petrobras posts record Q1 production, raises gas and aviation fuel prices, launches P-79 platform
stories.summary: Petrobras reported a record-breaking 3.23 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in Q1 2026, a 16% annual increase, while simultaneously raising natural gas prices 19.2% for distributors and jet fuel prices 18% — accumulating a 100% rise since the Iran war began — and commissioning the P-79 platform at Búzios ahead of schedule.

stories.headline: Presidential polls show Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in technical tie ahead of October election
stories.summary: Multiple polls released this week, including AtlasIntel/Bloomberg and BTG Pactual/Nexus, show Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in a statistical dead heat in simulated runoff scenarios. Lula's campaign coordinator called Flávio's rise a ceiling, while Haddad dismissed the polls as evidence of 'collective brainwashing.' Prediction markets on Polymarket also showed Flávio gaining.

stories.headline: PT holds 8th national congress, approves electoral manifesto and 2026 campaign strategy
stories.summary: The Workers' Party concluded its 8th national congress in Brasília, approving a manifesto centered on Lula's reelection, criticism of Trump, and proposals for judicial and media reform. The congress also showcased a digital strategy deploying 37 influencer-candidates, while PT regional directors made alliance decisions for key states including a break with PSD in Maranhão.

stories.headline: PT airs 'BolsoMaster' video linking Flávio to bank scandal; PL files complaint with PGR
stories.summary: During its national congress, the PT screened a video calling Flávio Bolsonaro the 'most corrupt son' and associating him with the Banco Master scandal. The PL formally asked the Attorney General to investigate the PT, Flávio denied any connection to the bank and its owner Daniel Vorcaro, and analysts noted both sides are using the Banco Master case as political ammunition.

stories.headline: Bolsonaro undergoes shoulder surgery while serving home detention; medical updates dominate coverage
stories.summary: Former president Jair Bolsonaro was hospitalized at Hospital DF Star in Brasília for a rotator cuff repair on his right shoulder, authorized by STF Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Michelle Bolsonaro provided multiple social media health updates as he began rehabilitation, with expected discharge on Monday. Bolsonaro continues serving home detention following his coup conviction.
